title: Suspicious process event creation from VMWare Horizon TomcatService
description: Microsoft has observed attackers who have gained entry to an environment via the Log4J vulnerability utilizing the ws_TomcatService.exe process to launch malicious processes.
query: ('Log Source' = 'Microsoft Defender Endpoint Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ('Parent Process Name' like '*ws_TomcatService.exe*') and ('Process Name' != 'repadmin.exe')
